$comment: Speedrunners action deck. Mixed baseline: the original seed helpers remain provisional so current tests keep a stable fixture deck, while page-1 source-backed cards from 'Sp 03 Action Cards' are now transcribed with record-level provenance. Full deck transcription is still tracked in tasks/BACKLOG.md.

cards.name: Octagon "dex"
cards.summary: Attach to a pawn as an add-on; the pawn ignores direction arrows.

cards.name: Simstim Record
cards.summary: Attach to a pawn as an add-on; while you control this card, gain one bonus counter.

cards.name: DJ
cards.summary: Attach to a pawn as an add-on; while you control this card, you choose the music that plays during the game.

cards.name: Accelerator
cards.summary: Attach to a pawn as an add-on. The printed card identifies this copy as Accelerator with transgenic therapy branding.

cards.name: Hyper Accelerator
cards.summary: Attach to a pawn as an add-on. The printed source identifies this as a Hyper Accelerator card.

cards.name: Accela Accelerator
cards.summary: Attach to a pawn as an add-on. The printed source identifies this as an Accela Accelerator card.

cards.name: Biochip
cards.summary: Attach to a pawn as an add-on. The printed source names Biochip and marks the card for Icebreaker use.

cards.name: E-Synapse Neural Interface
cards.summary: Attach to a pawn as an add-on. The printed source names E-Synapse neural interface and marks the card for Icebreaker use.

cards.name: Cracker
cards.summary: Use with Icebreaker on a block; place the Cracker in this block under your control.
